name: GeneSPIDER
description: Provides controlled synthetic networks and data properties to evaluate performance of gene regulatory network inference methods.
general_score_metric: AUPR and AUROC (primary reported metrics for recovered network edges)
typical_sota_score: varies widely by simulation setting; AUROC roughly ~0.6–0.95, AUPR ~0.2–0.8 in published comparisons
reputation: Known within computational biology/bioinformatics for benchmarking gene regulatory network inference on controlled synthetic data; used by researchers comparing inference algorithms.
notes: Synthetic networks — useful for controlled comparisons but may not reflect all complexities of real biological data; non‑LLM benchmark; performance highly sensitive to simulation parameters and sparsity.
